0x0.name: m_nTaskFn
0x0.source: [A 级汇编 2026-11-18] 任务回调(int形态,调用方传 (int)CCBStage::ProcMagic 等)。dispatcher==3 派发 VA=0x4fcb95: call [edi+0x40]=本字段(ecx=this+[rec+4],push 0); dispatcher==4 VA=0x4fcb1a: 与 ProcFiveLienupFadeOut 比对; StartSubTask 锚 VA=0x4fce29: lea esi,[..+0xB8] | 2026-11-25 成员型修正: int→_DWORD * (下标走查 0x3[v]/0x118[v] = 指针语义, lvar override 遮蔽回滚—用户裁定成员型层修)

0x4.name: m_nTaskArg0
0x4.source: [A] VA=0x4fcb8e: mov ecx,[edi+0x44] → this'=this+本值 (==3 派发实参); ==4 零检三元之一(0x4fcb29); slot0 本字段兼组级 actionId (dispatcher==4 VA=0x4fcb17: mov [edx-0x30]=B+20=slots[0]+4)

0xc.name: m_nTaskArg2
0xc.source: [A] ==4 零检 VA=0x4fcb30: mov ecx,[eax-0x38h] (第三元 0x4fcb37)

0x10.name: m_nState
0x10.source: [A] 四方同址互证: GetTaskID VA=0x4fcbf0 写3(任务已派发)/StartSubTask VA=0x4fce62 写4(完成或强停)/dispatcher VA=0x4fcac9 读{2,3,4}分支/GetTaskState VA=0x4fcc2a 从本址步进80 扫连续==4。语义: 2=等前置槽, 3=已派发运行, 4=完成

0x18.name: m_fStartTime
0x18.source: [A] GetTaskID VA=0x4fcbff: fstp 本址=系统时钟([vptr+0x50]); StartSubTask VA=0x4fce47 与 IsSubTaskFinished 读 elapsed=now-本值

0x1c.name: m_fMaxWait
0x1c.source: [A] dispatcher==2 分支 VA=0x4fcb50: fld 本址 与 flt_56A644 比对(<0 疑禁用); VA=0x4fcb6c: now-ts(前槽) ≥ 本值 → GetTaskID 派发本槽(链式等待超时)

0x20.name: m_fDuration
0x20.source: [A] StartSubTask VA=0x4fce4a: now-ts ≥ 本值 → 强停 state=4; IsSubTaskFinished: 本值×0.25 与 ×0.75 为回合推进里程碑阈值

0x24.name: m_nActionId
0x24.source: [A] dispatcher==4 VA=0x4fcb09: v7=本值(前槽cs-1) → 写组头 slots[0].m_nTaskArg0(B+20); fallback VA=0x4fcb3e: 前二槽(cs-2)同字段(条件: 前槽回调==ProcFiveLienupFadeOut 且三参全零)

0x28.name: m_bActive
0x28.source: [A] dispatcher 顶门 VA=0x4fcab1: mov al,[edi+0x68]=本字节, ==0 → break (槽未登记则跳过该组)

0x29.name: m_bRegistered
0x29.source: [A] StartSubTask VA=0x4fce20 读/VA=0x4fce32 写1; IsSubTaskFinished 同址: 0→1 时同时清 m_nTurnState (首访初始化对)

0x2b.name: m_bForceDone
0x2b.source: [A] StartSubTask VA=0x4fce3c: cmp 本字节,1 → 直接 state=4 强停(外部强制结束标志, SetForceFinishThrowingWeapon 族写入)

0x40.name: m_nTurnState
0x40.source: [A] IsSubTaskFinished: m_bRegistered 0→1 时清零; 低字节作 EndTurnAndAdvance 第5实参(回合状态码)
